name: Hotel Austria
beschreibung: The Hotel Austria is situated in a quiet location in Tirol, surrounded by the typical Alpine landscape. The amenities include a restaurant with regional cuisine and a wellness area with sauna. The rooms are furnished with local wood and have a balcony with mountain views. From here, guests can start hikes directly into the surrounding nature. In winter, the nearest ski slopes and cross-country ski trails can be reached quickly by car. The hotel offers parking for arriving guests and Wi-Fi in the public areas.
